description: Answer an open whisper. Where the question carried options, the answer must name one of them.

answer.description: Free-text answer, for a whisper with no options.

answer_option.description: The id of the chosen option. Required when the whisper carried options.

comment.description: Anything else the answerer wants recorded alongside the answer.

whisper_id.description: Identifier returned by chap.whisper.ask. A whisper that has already been answered is refused with -32020, and one past its deadline with -32021.
